clues.summary: a parcel left at the door that nobody in the flat ordered
clues.note: Beat 1's had Ren's name on it. The ones after do not. Same clue, and the difference is the point.

clues.summary: the front light, on a sensor, on all night
clues.note: Something was in front of it. The flat decided it was foxes.

clues.summary: the heating coming on at an hour nobody set
clues.note: A timer nobody set is a timer somebody set.

clues.summary: the rota taken off the fridge
clues.note: Small, indoors, and nobody in the flat did it.

clues.summary: a sound on the stairs that only one person heard
clues.note: Only load-bearing if Ren says he heard it too.

clues.summary: a sign-in from a device Ren does not own
clues.note: The one clue that arrives without anyone choosing to notice it.
